<!--
  Analysis code for the manuscript on sensory impairment, frailty, and incident
  dementia in the HRS (United States) and ELSA (England) cohorts.

  DATA NOT INCLUDED. HRS and ELSA are restricted-access and cannot be
  redistributed. Obtain the source data from the data providers and place them
  under data/ (git-ignored) so the relative paths in this notebook resolve.
  See README.md for setup and run order.
-->

<!--
What this notebook draws
  Fig. 3              Models 1-4: HR + PAF, hearing / vision / frailty, HRS and ELSA
  Fig. 4              Model 5 (frailty context): HR + PAF, hearing / vision
  Suppl. Fig. 9       Subgroup analyses by age and sex (forestploter)
  Suppl. Figs 10-11   Fine-Gray competing-risk sensitivity (HRS only)
  Suppl. Figs 12-13   Two-wave exposure lag
  Suppl. Figs 14-15   Reduced frailty index (no (I)ADL / affective CES-D items)
  Suppl. Figs 16-17   Attained age as the time scale

Where the numbers come from (all identical to the Supplementary Tables)
(all result files are read from results/, written by the analysis notebooks)
  * Models 2-5, primary analysis  -> age_timescale_PAF_{HRS,ELSA}.csv, scale == "time_since_baseline"
                                     (Supplementary Tables 33 and 40)
  * Model 1, primary analysis      -> PAF_Models1to5_{HRS,ELSA}.csv (Supplementary Table 33)
  * Attained-age time scale        -> age_timescale_PAF_{HRS,ELSA}.csv, scale == "attained_age"
                                     (Supplementary Table 49)
  * Two-wave lag                   -> lag2_sensitivity_{HRS,ELSA}.csv (Supplementary Tables 45-46)
  * Reduced frailty index          -> reducedFI_sensitivity_{HRS,ELSA}.csv (Supplementary Tables 47-48)
  * Fine-Gray (HRS)                -> finegray_PAF_HRS.csv (Supplementary Tables 43-44)
  * Person-time prevalence (p_pt)  -> the same CSVs (Fine-Gray and Model 1 use the primary p_pt,
                                     because they use the same analytic sample)

Every figure also writes the exact numbers it plots to <name>_plotted_values.csv,
so each panel can be checked against the Supplementary Tables.
-->

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ---- Paths ------------------------------------------------------------------
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the REPOSITORY ROOT, not to code/.
#
# RStudio runs .Rmd chunks with the working directory set to the notebook's own
# folder, so without this the code would look for code/data/ instead of data/.
# The root is resolved into a variable rather than with setwd(), because a
# setwd() inside a chunk does not persist to the next chunk.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
repo_root <- if (basename(getwd()) == "code") normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
cat("Repository root:", repo_root, "\n")
results_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "results")   # written by the analysis notebooks
out_dir     <- file.path(repo_root, "output")    # figures
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

f_hrs  <- function(x) file.path(results_dir, x)
f_elsa <- function(x) file.path(results_dir, x)

# ---- Shared look ------------------------------------------------------------
pal         <- c(HRS = "#0072B2", ELSA = "#D55E00")   # Okabe-Ito
base_family <- "Helvetica"
model_levels <- c("M4", "M3", "M2", "M1")              # M1 drawn on top

model_labels_sensory <- c(
  M1 = "Model 1\nUnadjusted",
  M2 = "Model 2\n+ chronological age",
  M3 = "Model 3\n+ sociodemographic and\nlifestyle factors",
  M4 = "Model 4\n+ frailty status"
)
model_labels_frailty <- c(
  M1 = "Model 1\nUnadjusted",
  M2 = "Model 2\n+ chronological age",
  M3 = "Model 3\n+ sociodemographic and\nlifestyle factors",
  M4 = "Model 4\n+ sensory impairments"
)
# Attained age is the time scale, so Model 2 adjusts for age through the time scale.
model_labels_sensory_age <- replace(model_labels_sensory, "M2",
                                    "Model 2\n+ attained age\n(time scale)")
model_labels_frailty_age <- replace(model_labels_frailty, "M2",
                                    "Model 2\n+ attained age\n(time scale)")

pathway_labels <- c(
  Before = "Before frailty onset",
  With   = "With or subsequent to\nfrailty onset",
  Total  = "Total context"
)
exposure_titles <- c(Hearing = "Hearing impairment",
                     Vision  = "Vision impairment",
                     Frailty = "Frailty")
```

```{r data-helpers}
# Every loader returns one of two standard long tables:
#   models  : cohort, exposure, model (M1-M4), HR, lcl, ucl, prev, paf, lo, hi
#   context : cohort, exposure, pathway (Before / With / Total), HR, lcl, ucl, paf, lo, hi
# PAFs are on the % scale.

exposure_from <- function(x) case_when(
  grepl("^Hearing", x) ~ "Hearing",
  grepl("^Vision",  x) ~ "Vision",
  grepl("^Frailty", x) ~ "Frailty"
)
pathway_from <- function(x) case_when(
  grepl("no frailty yet",  x) ~ "Before",
  grepl("frailty present", x) ~ "With",
  grepl("^Total",          x) ~ "Total"
)

# ---- age_timescale_PAF_*.csv (primary analysis and attained-age analysis) ----
read_timescale <- function(cohort, scale_wanted) {
  path <- if (cohort == "HRS") f_hrs("age_timescale_PAF_HRS.csv")
          else                 f_elsa("age_timescale_PAF_ELSA.csv")
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(scale == scale_wanted) %>%
    mutate(cohort = cohort)
}

timescale_models <- function(cohort, scale_wanted) {
  read_timescale(cohort, scale_wanted) %>%
    filter(grepl("^M[234] ", model)) %>%
    # Model 4: hearing/vision come from the hybrid frailty-adjusted model,
    # frailty from the mutually adjusted model (as in Supplementary Table 33).
    filter(!(grepl("^M4", model) & exposure %in% c("Hearing loss", "Vision loss") &
               !grepl("hybrid", model)),
           !(grepl("^M4", model) & exposure == "Frailty" &
               !grepl("mutually", model))) %>%
    transmute(cohort,
              exposure = exposure_from(exposure),
              model    = substr(model, 1, 2),
              HR, lcl = HR_lcl, ucl = HR_ucl,
              prev = p_pt,
              paf = 100 * PAF, lo = 100 * PAF_lcl, hi = 100 * PAF_ucl)
}

timescale_context <- function(cohort, scale_wanted) {
  read_timescale(cohort, scale_wanted) %>%
    filter(grepl("^M5", model)) %>%
    transmute(cohort,
              pathway  = pathway_from(exposure),   # must come before exposure is overwritten
              exposure = if_else(grepl("hearing", model), "Hearing", "Vision"),
              HR, lcl = HR_lcl, ucl = HR_ucl,
              paf = 100 * PAF, lo = 100 * PAF_lcl, hi = 100 * PAF_ucl)
}

# ---- lag2_ / reducedFI_sensitivity_*.csv ------------------------------------
read_sens <- function(prefix, cohort) {
  path <- if (cohort == "HRS") f_hrs(sprintf("%s_sensitivity_HRS.csv", prefix))
          else                 f_elsa(sprintf("%s_sensitivity_ELSA.csv", prefix))
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(cohort = cohort)
}
sens_models <- function(prefix) {
  bind_rows(read_sens(prefix, "HRS"), read_sens(prefix, "ELSA")) %>%
    filter(grepl("^Model [1-4]$", model)) %>%
    transmute(cohort,
              exposure = exposure_from(exposure),
              model    = sub("Model ", "M", model),
              HR, lcl = HR_lcl, ucl = HR_ucl,
              prev = p_pt,
              paf = 100 * PAF, lo = 100 * PAF_lcl, hi = 100 * PAF_ucl)
}
sens_context <- function(prefix) {
  bind_rows(read_sens(prefix, "HRS"), read_sens(prefix, "ELSA")) %>%
    filter(grepl("^Model 5", model)) %>%
    transmute(cohort,
              pathway  = pathway_from(exposure),   # must come before exposure is overwritten
              exposure = if_else(grepl("hearing", model), "Hearing", "Vision"),
              HR, lcl = HR_lcl, ucl = HR_ucl,
              paf = 100 * PAF, lo = 100 * PAF_lcl, hi = 100 * PAF_ucl)
}

# ---- Person-time prevalence of each exposure in the primary analytic sample -
prev_primary <- bind_rows(timescale_models("HRS",  "time_since_baseline"),
                          timescale_models("ELSA", "time_since_baseline")) %>%
  distinct(cohort, exposure, prev)

check_complete <- function(d, n_expected, what) {
  if (nrow(d) != n_expected || anyNA(select(d, -any_of("HR"), -any_of(c("lcl", "ucl")))))
    stop(sprintf("%s: expected %d complete rows, got %d. Check the input files.",
                 what, n_expected, nrow(d)))
  invisible(d)
}
```

```{r plot-helpers}
nice_ceiling <- function(x, step) ceiling(x / step) * step
nice_floor   <- function(x, step) floor(x / step) * step

# Linear HR axis with room on the right for the "HR (95% CI)" labels.
hr_axis <- function(d) {
  lo  <- min(0.8, nice_floor(min(d$lcl, na.rm = TRUE), 0.1))
  hi  <- nice_ceiling(max(d$ucl, na.rm = TRUE), if (max(d$ucl, na.rm = TRUE) > 2.5) 0.5 else 0.1)
  brk <- pretty(c(lo, hi), n = 5)
  brk <- brk[brk >= lo & brk <= hi]
  list(xlim = c(lo, hi), breaks = brk, label_x = hi + 0.03 * (hi - lo))
}
# PAF axis: data range plus room on the right for the "PAF (95% CI)" labels.
paf_axis <- function(d) {
  lo   <- min(0, nice_floor(min(d$lo, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) - 1
  hi   <- max(d$hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  brk  <- pretty(c(min(0, lo), hi), n = 7)
  brk  <- brk[brk >= lo & brk <= max(brk[brk <= hi + diff(brk)[1]])]
  span <- max(brk) - lo
  list(xlim = c(lo, max(brk) + 0.42 * span), breaks = brk,
       label_x = max(brk) + 0.04 * span)
}

with_y <- function(d, level_col, levels) {
  two <- n_distinct(d$cohort) > 1
  d %>% mutate(
    !!level_col := factor(.data[[level_col]], levels = levels),
    cohort      = factor(cohort, levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
    y_num       = as.numeric(.data[[level_col]]) +
                  if (two) ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18) else 0
  )
}

panel_theme <- function(show_y_text, legend = "none") {
  theme_classic(base_family = base_family, base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8, hjust = 0,
                                     margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey25",
                                     margin = margin(b = 4)),
    axis.line.x       = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x      = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.ticks.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y       = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                      lineheight = 0.85)
                        else element_blank(),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = legend,
    legend.justification = "right",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.width  = unit(10, "pt"),
    legend.key.height = unit(8, "pt"),
    legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin       = margin(4, 12, 4, 4)
  )
}

hr_panel <- function(d, ax, y_levels, y_labels, title = NULL,
                     show_x_title = FALSE, total_placeholder = FALSE) {
  d <- d %>% mutate(label = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", HR, lcl, ucl))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = HR, y = y_num, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lcl, xmax = ucl), width = 0, orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = ax$label_x, label = label), colour = "black",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = base_family, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = ax$breaks, limits = ax$xlim,
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.55)),
                       oob = scales::oob_keep) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(y_levels),
                       labels = y_labels[y_levels],
                       limits = c(0.4, length(y_levels) + 0.6),
                       expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 16, size = 2))) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = if (show_x_title) "Hazard ratio for incident dementia" else NULL,
         y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    panel_theme(show_y_text = TRUE, legend = "top")
  p
}

paf_panel <- function(d, ax, y_levels, show_x_title = FALSE, prevalence = NULL) {
  d <- d %>% mutate(paf_lab = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", paf, lo, hi),
                    is_total = if ("pathway" %in% names(d)) pathway == "Total" else FALSE)
  subtitle <- NULL
  if (!is.null(prevalence)) {
    subtitle <- prevalence %>%
      mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("HRS", "ELSA"))) %>%
      arrange(cohort) %>%
      mutate(txt = sprintf("%s %.1f%%", cohort, 100 * prev)) %>%
      pull(txt) %>% paste(collapse = "  ·  ") %>%
      paste0("Person-time prevalence: ", .)
  }
  ggplot(d, aes(y = y_num, x = paf, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = paf, yend = y_num), linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = is_total), size = 1.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(aes(x = ax$label_x, label = paf_lab), colour = "black",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = base_family, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = ax$breaks, labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                       limits = ax$xlim, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(y_levels), labels = NULL,
                       limits = c(0.4, length(y_levels) + 0.6),
                       expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
    labs(subtitle = subtitle,
         x = if (show_x_title) "Population attributable fraction for incident dementia (%)" else NULL,
         y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    panel_theme(show_y_text = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))
}

compose <- function(rows, heights) {
  wrap_plots(rows, ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1.05), heights = heights,
             guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "right",
          legend.box.margin = margin(b = -2))
}

# ---- Figure type A: Models 1-4, rows = hearing / vision / frailty -----------
fig_models <- function(d, sensory_labels = model_labels_sensory,
                       frailty_labels = model_labels_frailty) {
  levels_used <- intersect(model_levels, unique(d$model))
  d   <- with_y(d, "model", levels_used)
  axh <- hr_axis(d); axp <- paf_axis(d)
  rows <- list()
  exps <- c("Hearing", "Vision", "Frailty")
  for (i in seq_along(exps)) {
    e    <- exps[i]; last <- i == length(exps)
    labs <- if (e == "Frailty") frailty_labels else sensory_labels
    de   <- filter(d, exposure == e)
    rows <- c(rows, list(
      hr_panel(de, axh, levels_used, labs,
               title = bquote(bold(.(letters[i])) ~ ~ .(exposure_titles[[e]])),
               show_x_title = last),
      paf_panel(de, axp, levels_used, show_x_title = last,
                prevalence = distinct(de, cohort, prev))
    ))
  }
  compose(rows, heights = rep(1, length(exps)))
}

# ---- Figure type B: Model 5 context, rows = hearing / vision ----------------
fig_context <- function(d) {
  levels_used <- c("Total", "With", "Before")
  if (!any(d$pathway == "Total")) levels_used <- c("With", "Before")
  d  <- with_y(d, "pathway", levels_used)
  dh <- filter(d, pathway != "Total")
  axh <- hr_axis(dh); axp <- paf_axis(d)
  rows <- list()
  exps <- c("Hearing", "Vision")
  for (i in seq_along(exps)) {
    e <- exps[i]; last <- i == length(exps)
    rows <- c(rows, list(
      hr_panel(filter(dh, exposure == e), axh, levels_used, pathway_labels,
               title = bquote(bold(.(letters[i])) ~ ~ .(exposure_titles[[e]])),
               show_x_title = last),
      paf_panel(filter(d, exposure == e), axp, levels_used, show_x_title = last)
    ))
  }
  compose(rows, heights = c(1, 1))
}

save_fig <- function(fig, name, height_mm, data = NULL) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), fig,
         width = 183, height = height_mm, units = "mm",
         device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), fig,
           width = 183, height = height_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
           device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
  } else {
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), fig,
           width = 183, height = height_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  }
  if (!is.null(data))
    write_csv(data, file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, "_plotted_values.csv")))
  message("saved ", name)
}
```

<!--
SUPPLEMENTARY FIG. 9 - Subgroup analyses by age and sex.
These two chunks read the subgroup_*.rds results written by the Cox notebooks.
The first chunk draws separate HR and PAF forests, the second the combined version.
-->

```{r suppfig-09-subgroup-separate}
library(forestploter); library(grid); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(purrr);       library(tibble); library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. Load + sanity check ----------------------------------------------
sub_HRS  <- readRDS(f_hrs("subgroup_HRS.rds"))
sub_ELSA <- readRDS(f_elsa("subgroup_ELSA.rds"))

# Each file is a list with $cox (fitted subgroup models), $paf and $forest,
# as saved by the subgroup chunk of the *_analysis_Cox.Rmd notebooks.
stopifnot(all(c("cox", "paf") %in% names(sub_HRS)),
          all(c("cox", "paf") %in% names(sub_ELSA)))
get_cox <- function(x) x$cox
get_paf <- function(x) x$paf
cox_HRS  <- get_cox(sub_HRS);   paf_HRS  <- get_paf(sub_HRS)
cox_ELSA <- get_cox(sub_ELSA);  paf_ELSA <- get_paf(sub_ELSA)

stopifnot(!identical(cox_HRS, cox_ELSA))
cat("HRS m4_h n_int[1] =", cox_HRS$m4_h$n_int[1],
    "  ELSA m4_h n_int[1] =", cox_ELSA$m4_h$n_int[1], "\n")

# ---- 2. HR pipeline: split M5 + merge cohorts ----------------------------
split_m5 <- function(res) list(
  nf = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                         HR = HR_1, lo = lo_1, hi = hi_1, p_int),
  fr = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                         HR = HR_2, lo = lo_2, hi = hi_2, p_int)
)
HRS_m5h  <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_h);  HRS_m5v  <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_v)
ELSA_m5h <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_h); ELSA_m5v <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_v)

merge_cohorts <- function(res_HRS, res_ELSA) {
  full_join(
    res_HRS  %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_HRS = HR, lo_HRS = lo, hi_HRS = hi,
                           p_HRS  = p_int),
    res_ELSA %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_ELSA = HR, lo_ELSA = lo, hi_ELSA = hi,
                           p_ELSA  = p_int),
    by = c("group","stratum")
  )
}
sec <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_h, cox_ELSA$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_v, cox_ELSA$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_f, cox_ELSA$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5h$nf,   ELSA_m5h$nf),
  m5_h_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5h$fr,   ELSA_m5h$fr),
  m5_v_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5v$nf,   ELSA_m5v$nf),
  m5_v_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5v$fr,   ELSA_m5v$fr)
)

# ---- 2b. PAF pipeline: extract per-section PAFs + merge cohorts ----------
# Borrow p_int from the matching HR section so the PAF plot can show the
# same interaction p-values.
extract_paf <- function(paf, model_id, exposure_label) {
  paf %>%
    filter(model == model_id, exposure == exposure_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, stratum, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)
}
merge_paf <- function(p_HRS_tab, p_ELSA_tab, model_id, exposure_label, sec_entry) {
  hrs <- extract_paf(p_HRS_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_HRS = 100 * PAF,
              lo_HRS  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_HRS  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  elsa <- extract_paf(p_ELSA_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_ELSA = 100 * PAF,
              lo_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  pints <- sec_entry %>% transmute(group, stratum, p_HRS, p_ELSA)
  hrs %>%
    full_join(elsa,  by = c("group", "stratum")) %>%
    left_join(pints, by = c("group", "stratum"))
}

# PAF table uses the original long factor labels ("Hearing loss, ...").
sec_paf <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Hearing loss",                   sec$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Vision loss",                    sec$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Frailty",                        sec$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, no frailty yet",   sec$m5_h_nf),
  m5_h_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, frailty present",  sec$m5_h_fr),
  m5_v_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, no frailty yet",    sec$m5_v_nf),
  m5_v_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, frailty present",   sec$m5_v_fr)
)

# ---- 3. Formatters --------------------------------------------------------
fmt_hr  <- function(x, l, u)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", x, l, u))
fmt_paf <- function(x, l, u)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", x, l, u))
fmt_p   <- function(p)
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < .001, "<.001",
                # 3 decimals below .01 so e.g. .003 is not shown as ".00"
                sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf(ifelse(p < .01, "%.3f", "%.2f"), p))))

# ---- 4. Section-chunk builders (HR and PAF) ------------------------------
build_section_chunk <- function(res, section_title,
                                est_HRS, lo_HRS_v, hi_HRS_v,
                                est_ELSA, lo_ELSA_v, hi_ELSA_v,
                                fmt_fn) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Subgroup = section_title,
           est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
           est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
           hrs_txt = "", elsa_txt = "",
           p_hrs = "", p_elsa = "",
           row_type = "section"),
    res %>% group_split(group) %>% map_dfr(function(df) {
      # Pull values out FIRST so tibble's data masking can't redefine
      # est_HRS/lo_HRS_v/... as the newly-created columns.
      vH  <- df[[est_HRS]];   vlH <- df[[lo_HRS_v]];   vhH <- df[[hi_HRS_v]]
      vE  <- df[[est_ELSA]];  vlE <- df[[lo_ELSA_v]];  vhE <- df[[hi_ELSA_v]]
      bind_rows(
        tibble(Subgroup = df$group[1],
               est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
               est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
               hrs_txt = "", elsa_txt = "",
               p_hrs  = fmt_p(df$p_HRS[1]),
               p_elsa = fmt_p(df$p_ELSA[1]),
               row_type = "group"),
        tibble(
          Subgroup = paste0("   ", as.character(df$stratum)),
          est_HRS  = vH,   lo_HRS  = vlH,  hi_HRS  = vhH,
          est_ELSA = vE,   lo_ELSA = vlE,  hi_ELSA = vhE,
          hrs_txt  = fmt_fn(vH, vlH, vhH),
          elsa_txt = fmt_fn(vE, vlE, vhE),
          p_hrs = "", p_elsa = "",
          row_type = "stratum"
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

section_titles <- c(
  m4_h    = "Model 4: Hearing impairment",
  m4_v    = "Model 4: Vision impairment",
  m4_f    = "Model 4: Frailty (mutually adjusted)",
  m5_h_nf = "Model 5: Hearing impairment before frailty onset",
  m5_h_fr = "Model 5: Hearing impairment with or subsequent to frailty onset",
  m5_v_nf = "Model 5: Vision impairment before frailty onset",
  m5_v_fr = "Model 5: Vision impairment with or subsequent to frailty onset"
)

combined_hr <- bind_rows(map2(
  sec, section_titles[names(sec)],
  ~ build_section_chunk(.x, .y,
                        "HR_HRS",  "lo_HRS",  "hi_HRS",
                        "HR_ELSA", "lo_ELSA", "hi_ELSA",
                        fmt_hr)
))
combined_paf <- bind_rows(map2(
  sec_paf, section_titles[names(sec_paf)],
  ~ build_section_chunk(.x, .y,
                        "PAF_HRS",  "lo_HRS",  "hi_HRS",
                        "PAF_ELSA", "lo_ELSA", "hi_ELSA",
                        fmt_paf)
))

# ---- 5. Theme ------------------------------------------------------------
HRS_COLOR  <- "#0072B2"   # navy blue
ELSA_COLOR <- "#D55E00"   # vermillion

nc_theme <- forest_theme(
  base_size        = 8.5,
  base_family      = "sans",
  refline_gp       = gpar(col = "grey45", lty = "dotted", lwd = 0.6),
  ci_pch           = c(15, 16),
  ci_col           = c(HRS_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR),
  ci_fill          = c(HRS_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR),
  ci_lwd           = 0.9,
  ci_Theight       = 0,
  xaxis_gp         = gpar(cex = 0.72, lwd = 0.55),
  colhead          = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "bold", cex = 0.80)),
  core             = list(bg_params = list(fill = "white", col = NA)),
  arrow_type       = "open",
  arrow_label_just = "end",
  legend_name      = "Cohort",
  legend_value     = c("HRS", "ELSA"),
  legend_position  = "bottom"
)

# ---- 6. Forest builders --------------------------------------------------
# Column order (same for HR and PAF):
#   1 Subgroup | 2 est HRS | 3 [HRS panel] | 4 P int | 5 est ELSA | 6 [ELSA panel] | 7 P int
make_forest <- function(pdf,
                        est_label,     # column header for estimate text
                        ref_line,
                        x_breaks,
                        x_trans   = "none",
                        arrow_lab) {
  blank <- paste(rep(" ", 22), collapse = " ")
  d <- tibble(
    `Subgroup`          = pdf$Subgroup,
    !!est_label         := pdf$hrs_txt,
    `HRS`               = blank,
    `P interaction`     = pdf$p_hrs,
    !!paste0(est_label, " ") := pdf$elsa_txt,
    `ELSA`              = blank,
    `P interaction `    = pdf$p_elsa
  )

  p <- forest(
    data       = d,
    est        = list(pdf$est_HRS, pdf$est_ELSA),
    lower      = list(pdf$lo_HRS,  pdf$lo_ELSA),
    upper      = list(pdf$hi_HRS,  pdf$hi_ELSA),
    sizes      = 0.45,
    ci_column  = c(3, 6),
    ref_line   = ref_line,
    arrow_lab  = arrow_lab,
    xlim       = c(min(x_breaks), max(x_breaks)),
    ticks_at   = x_breaks,
    x_trans    = x_trans,
    theme      = nc_theme
  )

  sec_rows <- which(pdf$row_type == "section")
  for (r in sec_rows)
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 8.8))
  for (r in which(pdf$row_type == "group"))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
  for (r in sec_rows[-1])
    p <- add_border(p, row = r, part = "body", where = "top",
                    gp = gpar(lwd = 0.4, col = "grey70"))

  stratum_rows <- which(pdf$row_type == "stratum")
  for (r in stratum_rows) {
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 3, which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = HRS_COLOR,  fill = HRS_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 6, which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = ELSA_COLOR, fill = ELSA_COLOR))
  }
  p
}

# HR forest (log scale, ref = 1)
p_hr <- make_forest(
  combined_hr,
  est_label = "HR (95% CI)",
  ref_line  = 1,
  x_breaks  = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
  x_trans   = "log",
  arrow_lab = c("Lower risk", "Higher risk")
)

# PAF forest (linear scale in %, ref = 0).
# Pick breaks from observed range, padded to nice integers.
paf_rng    <- range(c(combined_paf$lo_HRS, combined_paf$hi_HRS,
                      combined_paf$lo_ELSA, combined_paf$hi_ELSA),
                    na.rm = TRUE, finite = TRUE)
paf_breaks <- pretty(c(min(0, paf_rng[1]), paf_rng[2]), n = 6)

p_paf <- make_forest(
  combined_paf,
  est_label = "PAF (95% CI)",
  ref_line  = 0,
  x_breaks  = paf_breaks,
  x_trans   = "none",
  arrow_lab = c("Protective", "Attributable")
)

# ---- 7. Save -------------------------------------------------------------
# figures are written to out_dir (set in the setup chunk)
save_horizontal <- function(p, pdf, path, w = 12, row_h = 0.22, pad = 1.5) {
  h <- row_h * nrow(pdf) + pad
  ggsave(paste0(path, ".pdf"), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(paste0(path, ".png"), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", dpi = 600)
  message(sprintf("saved %s (%.1f x %.1f in)", basename(path), w, h))
}
save_horizontal(p_hr,  combined_hr,  file.path(out_dir, "SuppFig09_subgroup_HR_horizontal"))
save_horizontal(p_paf, combined_paf, file.path(out_dir, "SuppFig09_subgroup_PAF_horizontal"))

print(p_hr)
print(p_paf)
```

```{r suppfig-09-subgroup-combined}
library(forestploter); library(grid); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(purrr);       library(tibble); library(ggplot2)
# ragg (optional) gives sharper PNG anti-aliasing than the default device.

# ---- 1. Load results and sanity-check cohorts ----------------------------
sub_HRS  <- readRDS(f_hrs("subgroup_HRS.rds"))
sub_ELSA <- readRDS(f_elsa("subgroup_ELSA.rds"))

get_cox <- function(x) if (!is.null(x$cox)) x$cox else x
get_paf <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x$paf)) return(x$paf)
  stop("Population attributable fraction data not found in this RDS. ",
       "Re-save it as a list with $cox / $paf / $forest slots ",
       "(see the PAF + forest block).")
}
cox_HRS  <- get_cox(sub_HRS);   paf_HRS  <- get_paf(sub_HRS)
cox_ELSA <- get_cox(sub_ELSA);  paf_ELSA <- get_paf(sub_ELSA)

stopifnot(!identical(cox_HRS, cox_ELSA))
cat("HRS  m4_h n_interaction[1] =", cox_HRS$m4_h$n_int[1],
    "   ELSA m4_h n_interaction[1] =", cox_ELSA$m4_h$n_int[1], "\n")

# ---- 2. Hazard-ratio pipeline: split Model 5 and merge cohorts -----------
split_m5 <- function(res) list(
  no_frailty       = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                                       HR = HR_1, lo = lo_1, hi = hi_1, p_int),
  frailty_present  = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                                       HR = HR_2, lo = lo_2, hi = hi_2, p_int)
)
HRS_m5_hearing  <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_h)
HRS_m5_vision   <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_v)
ELSA_m5_hearing <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_h)
ELSA_m5_vision  <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_v)

merge_cohorts <- function(res_HRS, res_ELSA) {
  full_join(
    res_HRS  %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_HRS = HR, lo_HRS = lo, hi_HRS = hi,
                           p_interaction_HRS  = p_int),
    res_ELSA %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_ELSA = HR, lo_ELSA = lo, hi_ELSA = hi,
                           p_interaction_ELSA = p_int),
    by = c("group", "stratum")
  )
}
sec <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_h, cox_ELSA$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_v, cox_ELSA$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_f, cox_ELSA$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_hearing$no_frailty,      ELSA_m5_hearing$no_frailty),
  m5_h_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_hearing$frailty_present, ELSA_m5_hearing$frailty_present),
  m5_v_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_vision$no_frailty,       ELSA_m5_vision$no_frailty),
  m5_v_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_vision$frailty_present,  ELSA_m5_vision$frailty_present)
)

# ---- 2b. Population attributable fraction pipeline -----------------------
extract_paf <- function(paf, model_id, exposure_label) {
  paf %>%
    filter(model == model_id, exposure == exposure_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, stratum, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)
}
merge_paf <- function(paf_HRS_tab, paf_ELSA_tab,
                     model_id, exposure_label, sec_entry) {
  hrs <- extract_paf(paf_HRS_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_HRS = 100 * PAF,
              lo_HRS  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_HRS  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  elsa <- extract_paf(paf_ELSA_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_ELSA = 100 * PAF,
              lo_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  pints <- sec_entry %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                                   p_interaction_HRS, p_interaction_ELSA)
  hrs %>%
    full_join(elsa,  by = c("group", "stratum")) %>%
    left_join(pints, by = c("group", "stratum"))
}

sec_paf <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Hearing loss",                   sec$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Vision loss",                    sec$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Frailty",                        sec$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, no frailty yet",   sec$m5_h_nf),
  m5_h_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, frailty present",  sec$m5_h_fr),
  m5_v_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, no frailty yet",    sec$m5_v_nf),
  m5_v_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, frailty present",   sec$m5_v_fr)
)

# ---- 3. Formatters --------------------------------------------------------
format_hazard_ratio <- function(estimate, lower, upper)
  ifelse(is.na(estimate), "\u2014",
         sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", estimate, lower, upper))

format_paf <- function(estimate, lower, upper)
  ifelse(is.na(estimate), "\u2014",
         sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", estimate, lower, upper))

format_p_value <- function(p)
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < .001, "<.001",
                # 3 decimals below .01 so e.g. .003 is not shown as ".00"
                sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf(ifelse(p < .01, "%.3f", "%.2f"), p))))

# ---- 4. Section-chunk builder (shared by HR and PAF) --------------------
build_section_chunk <- function(res, section_title,
                                est_HRS, lo_HRS_v, hi_HRS_v,
                                est_ELSA, lo_ELSA_v, hi_ELSA_v,
                                format_fn) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Subgroup = section_title,
           est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
           est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
           hrs_text = "", elsa_text = "",
           p_interaction_hrs = "", p_interaction_elsa = "",
           row_type = "section"),
    res %>% group_split(group) %>% map_dfr(function(df) {
      vH  <- df[[est_HRS]];   vlH <- df[[lo_HRS_v]];   vhH <- df[[hi_HRS_v]]
      vE  <- df[[est_ELSA]];  vlE <- df[[lo_ELSA_v]];  vhE <- df[[hi_ELSA_v]]
      bind_rows(
        tibble(Subgroup = df$group[1],
               est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
               est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
               hrs_text = "", elsa_text = "",
               p_interaction_hrs  = format_p_value(df$p_interaction_HRS[1]),
               p_interaction_elsa = format_p_value(df$p_interaction_ELSA[1]),
               row_type = "group"),
        tibble(
          Subgroup  = paste0("   ", as.character(df$stratum)),
          est_HRS   = vH,  lo_HRS  = vlH, hi_HRS  = vhH,
          est_ELSA  = vE,  lo_ELSA = vlE, hi_ELSA = vhE,
          hrs_text  = format_fn(vH, vlH, vhH),
          elsa_text = format_fn(vE, vlE, vhE),
          p_interaction_hrs = "", p_interaction_elsa = "",
          row_type  = "stratum"
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# 6. Combined forest builder — forest plot FIRST, then numeric values
#    (consistent with Figs 3-4: plot on the left, values to the right)
# ============================================================================
make_combined_forest <- function(pdf_hr, pdf_paf,
                                 hr_breaks  = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
                                 paf_breaks) {

  # Wider blank string → CI panel columns get more horizontal real estate,
  # so HR / PAF distributions read more clearly.
  blank <- paste(rep(" ", 28), collapse = " ")

  # Each plotting column comes BEFORE its value column, so the forest plot
  # is drawn first and the numeric estimate sits to its right.
  # Column positions:
  #   1  Subgroup
  #   2  HRS  [Hazard ratio]   <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   3  Hazard ratio (95% CI)        <- values
  #   4  HRS  [PAF]            <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   5  PAF (95% CI)                 <- values
  #   6  P interaction (HRS)
  #   7  ELSA [Hazard ratio]   <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   8  Hazard ratio (95% CI)        <- values
  #   9  ELSA [PAF]            <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   10 PAF (95% CI)                 <- values
  #   11 P interaction (ELSA)
  d <- tibble(
    `Subgroup`                = pdf_hr$Subgroup,
    `HRS [Hazard ratio]`      = blank,
    `Hazard ratio (95% CI)`   = pdf_hr$hrs_text,
    `HRS [PAF]`               = blank,
    `PAF (95% CI)`            = pdf_paf$hrs_text,
    `P interaction (HRS)`     = pdf_hr$p_interaction_hrs,
    `ELSA [Hazard ratio]`     = blank,
    `Hazard ratio (95% CI) `  = pdf_hr$elsa_text,
    `ELSA [PAF]`              = blank,
    `PAF (95% CI) `           = pdf_paf$elsa_text,
    `P interaction (ELSA)`    = pdf_hr$p_interaction_elsa
  )

  p <- forest(
    data       = d,
    est        = list(pdf_hr$est_HRS,  pdf_paf$est_HRS,
                      pdf_hr$est_ELSA, pdf_paf$est_ELSA),
    lower      = list(pdf_hr$lo_HRS,   pdf_paf$lo_HRS,
                      pdf_hr$lo_ELSA,  pdf_paf$lo_ELSA),
    upper      = list(pdf_hr$hi_HRS,   pdf_paf$hi_HRS,
                      pdf_hr$hi_ELSA,  pdf_paf$hi_ELSA),
    sizes      = 0.60,
    ci_column  = c(2, 4, 7, 9),
    ref_line   = c(1, 0, 1, 0),
    arrow_lab  = list(c("Lower risk",  "Higher risk"),
                      c("Protective",  "Attributable"),
                      c("Lower risk",  "Higher risk"),
                      c("Protective",  "Attributable")),
    xlim       = list(c(min(hr_breaks),  max(hr_breaks)),
                      c(min(paf_breaks), max(paf_breaks)),
                      c(min(hr_breaks),  max(hr_breaks)),
                      c(min(paf_breaks), max(paf_breaks))),
    ticks_at   = list(hr_breaks, paf_breaks, hr_breaks, paf_breaks),
    x_trans    = c("log", "none", "log", "none"),
    theme      = nc_theme
  )

  section_rows <- which(pdf_hr$row_type == "section")
  for (r in section_rows)
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 10.8))
  for (r in which(pdf_hr$row_type == "group"))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
  for (r in section_rows[-1])
    p <- add_border(p, row = r, part = "body", where = "top",
                    gp = gpar(lwd = 0.6, col = "grey65"))

  # CI colours by plotting column.
  stratum_rows <- which(pdf_hr$row_type == "stratum")
  for (r in stratum_rows) {
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 2,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = HRS_COLOR,  fill = HRS_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 4,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = HRS_COLOR,  fill = HRS_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 7,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = ELSA_COLOR, fill = ELSA_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 9,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = ELSA_COLOR, fill = ELSA_COLOR))
  }

  p
}

paf_range  <- range(c(combined_paf$lo_HRS,  combined_paf$hi_HRS,
                      combined_paf$lo_ELSA, combined_paf$hi_ELSA),
                    na.rm = TRUE, finite = TRUE)
paf_breaks <- pretty(c(min(0, paf_range[1]), paf_range[2]), n = 6)

p_combined <- make_combined_forest(
  combined_hr, combined_paf,
  hr_breaks  = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
  paf_breaks = paf_breaks
)

# ============================================================================
# 7. Save — print quality at a moderate file size
# ============================================================================
# figures are written to out_dir (set in the setup chunk)

save_horizontal <- function(plot_obj, source_df, path,
                            width_in   = 18,
                            row_height = 0.26,
                            padding    = 1.6,
                            dpi_png    = 600) {  # print-quality without 4x blow-up

  height_in <- row_height * nrow(source_df) + padding

  # PDF — vector, always sharp, tiny file
  ggsave(paste0(path, ".pdf"), plot_obj,
         width = width_in, height = height_in,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

  # PNG — ragg if available, else cairo
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(paste0(path, ".png"), plot_obj,
           width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in",
           dpi = dpi_png, device = ragg::agg_png)
  } else {
    ggsave(paste0(path, ".png"), plot_obj,
           width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in",
           dpi = dpi_png, type = "cairo")
  }

  # TIFF — only if the journal asks for it; otherwise comment out.
  # Routed through ggsave so the plot fills the canvas the same way as the PNG.
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(paste0(path, ".tiff"), plot_obj,
           width  = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in",
           dpi    = 600,
           device = ragg::agg_tiff,
           compression = "lzw")
  }

  message(sprintf("saved %s (%.1f x %.1f in, %d dpi PNG)",
                  basename(path), width_in, height_in, dpi_png))
}

save_horizontal(p_combined, combined_hr,
                file.path(out_dir, "SuppFig09_subgroup_HR_PAF_combined"),
                width_in   = 24,    # 11 columns
                row_height = 0.26,
                padding    = 1.8)

print(p_combined)

```

```{r suppfig-10-11-finegray}
# ============================================================================
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGS 10-11 - Fine-Gray competing-risk model, HRS only
# (Supplementary Tables 43 and 44; read from finegray_PAF_HRS.csv)
# ============================================================================
fg_all <- read_csv(f_hrs("finegray_PAF_HRS.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

fg_models <- fg_all %>%
  filter(grepl("^FG-M[1-4]", model)) %>%
  transmute(cohort   = "HRS",
            exposure = exposure_from(exposure),
            model    = sub("^FG-(M[1-4]).*", "\\1", model),
            HR = sHR, lcl = sHR_lcl, ucl = sHR_ucl,
            prev = p_pt,
            paf = 100 * PAF, lo = 100 * PAF_lcl, hi = 100 * PAF_ucl) %>%
  check_complete(12, "Suppl. Fig. 10")

fg_context <- fg_all %>%
  filter(grepl("^FG-M5", model), !grepl("^Total", exposure)) %>%
  transmute(cohort   = "HRS",
            pathway  = pathway_from(exposure),   # must come before exposure is overwritten
            exposure = if_else(grepl("hearing", model), "Hearing", "Vision"),
            HR = sHR, lcl = sHR_lcl, ucl = sHR_ucl,
            paf = 100 * PAF, lo = 100 * PAF_lcl, hi = 100 * PAF_ucl)
stopifnot(nrow(fg_context) == 4, !anyNA(fg_context$pathway))

figS10 <- fig_models(fg_models)
figS11 <- fig_context(fg_context)
figS10; figS11
save_fig(figS10, "SuppFig10_FineGray_HR_PAF_Models1to4_HRS", 215, fg_models)
save_fig(figS11, "SuppFig11_FineGray_context_HR_PAF_Model5_HRS", 120, fg_context)
```
